summary: Bound KV offload loads promoted from secondary tiers by the primary (CPU) tier capacity
compatibility: Applies to TieringOffloadingSpec with secondary tiers: loads larger than the primary tier load a bounded prefix and recompute the rest instead of loading nothing. Hybrid models with windowed or recurrent groups need a prefix_cache_retention_interval other than 0 for the bound; with 0, or when the primary tier cannot hold one aligned load, loads stay unbounded and a warning says so. The bound is per request: concurrent promotions can still exceed the primary tier, and a lookup the bound shortened and that stays deferred longer than staged_load_timeout_s (300 s by default) recomputes. It also applies to hits already in the primary tier. A nonzero retention interval also changes GPU prefix-cache retention.
details: One load covers at most the tokens whose chunks, over all groups, fit in the CPU tier; the bound is logged at startup.
